recipes.title: Drop bar before the hook
recipes.intent: Drums play three bars and drop out for the fourth, so the hook lands on an empty bar's pickup.

recipes.title: Drop the beat on beat 4
recipes.intent: Every 4th bar the drums stop for the last beat: a gap that pulls into the next section.

recipes.title: Beat switch
recipes.intent: Two bars boom-bap, then the same harmony over a trap kit: the beat switches, the song does not.

recipes.title: Switch-up (same kit, new pattern)
recipes.intent: Kit and harmony stay; kick and bass flip to the bounce pattern every 4 bars.

recipes.title: Pickup fill into the next section
recipes.intent: Three bars of beat; in the fourth, a clap roll on beat 4 leads into the downbeat.

recipes.title: 808 pickup
recipes.intent: The 808 plays a two-note pickup in the last beat of every 4th bar, so the next downbeat feels caught.

recipes.title: Overlapping tail
recipes.intent: The pad section ends after bar 2 but its release and room ring into bar 3, where the keys enter: no hole between sections.

recipes.title: Call and response handoff
recipes.intent: The lead calls in the first half of each bar, the keys answer in the second: two parts share one space.

recipes.title: Equal-power crossfade between sections
recipes.intent: Over bar 4 the pad fades out on a cos table while the keys fade in on a sin table: constant loudness through the change.

recipes.title: Riser, impact, downlifter
recipes.intent: A two-bar riser ends exactly on the downbeat, the impact lands on the one, the downlifter falls after it.

recipes.title: Ducked transition
recipes.intent: The pad bed ducks under the impact on the one and breathes back over a bar.

recipes.title: Delay throw
recipes.intent: The last hit of every 4th bar is thrown into a dotted-8th delay that rings into the next bar.

recipes.title: Turnaround bar
recipes.intent: Three bars of the loop, then a turnaround bar on the V that pulls back into bar 1.

recipes.title: Lazy snare (push and pull per voice)

recipes.title: Humanize (seeded timing and velocity)
recipes.intent: Hats with 4 % timing spread and 15 % velocity spread; deterministic, so an offline render repeats exactly.

recipes.title: Drag vs rush

recipes.title: Tempo drift
recipes.intent: A keys part whose timing wanders slowly (smooth over four bars), like a player without a click.

recipes.intent: Em C D Bm on a drawbar-style organ and a string pad high-passed above.

recipes.title: Metal breakdown grammar
recipes.intent: 3+3+4+2+4 chug with the kick in unison, a half-time snare and a crash.

recipes.title: Riff grammar: A A A B
recipes.intent: A 4-bar riff built from two cells (call three times, answer once).

recipes.title: Doom riff
recipes.intent: One chord per two beats, held; bass held under it; kick once a bar.

recipes.title: Feel: straight rock
recipes.intent: kick 1, 3 and the and of 3, backbeat, 8th hats, crunch riff (100-140 bpm).

recipes.title: Feel: shuffle
recipes.intent: triplet-grid shuffle: kick and hats on the triplet grid, backbeat (90-130 bpm).

recipes.title: Feel: rock / metal half-time
recipes.intent: half-time snare on 3, ride quarters, high-gain riff (120-160 bpm (felt half)).

recipes.title: Feel: thrash
recipes.intent: skank beat (kick on beats, snare on offbeats) (160-220 bpm).

recipes.title: Feel: doom
recipes.intent: slow and heavy: kick once a bar, snare on 3, held doom riff and bass (55-80 bpm).
